texts.zh:
在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系中，有一个围绕着脉冲星的巨大残骸场。我们的科学家分析称，在残骸场内部最密集的区域所残存的部分完整结构似乎通过某种方式驾驭了恒星的力量，有将物体传送至极远距离的能力。

倘若我们获取了如何修复巨型结构的知识，我们将能够修复这座量子弹弓。
texts.en:
A massive field of debris orbits the pulsar in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system. Our scientists theorize that the partially intact structure in the densest portion of the field somehow harnessed the power of the star to launch objects incredible distances.

If we developed the knowledge to work on great megastructures, we could repair this Quantum Catapult.

texts.zh: 在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系中，有一个围绕着脉冲星的巨大残骸场，其核心的结构与我们的量子弹弓设计相似。经过彻底维修我们能够使其恢复运转。
texts.en: A massive field of debris orbits the pulsar in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system - the structure in the center is similar to that of our own Quantum Catapult designs. With extensive repairs, we could return it to service.

label.zh: 想象一下我们拥有两个量子弹弓的情景！
